thread:
Raj: ArgoCD just synced cluster-system and pushed cilium v1.14 to prod — seeing GPU nodes start flapping
Maya: yep, getting evictions for nvidia-device-plugin and gpustat pod crashes
Olivia: `kubectl get nodes -l node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu -o wide` -> 3 NotReady, kubelet LastHeartbeat shows kernel taint issues
Arjun: checked gitops history — there was a chart bump for gpu-daemon (PR #842) earlier today that changed tolerations in values.yaml
Maya: also seeing terraform drift: nodegroup launch_template name changed, plan wants to replace instances
Raj: logs from cilium-agent show failures attaching ENIs: "failed to allocate address for pod" — possible subnet tagging mismatch after chart applied
Olivia: can we rollback the Helm chart via Argo? `argocd app rollback cluster-system 2` would revert the chart commit that removed tolerations
Devops-bot: incident created INC-2026-83 for cluster instability (paging oncall)
Sre-oncall: oncall responding — what immediate mitigation do we want? rollback or manual patch?
Raj: manual patch faster: re-add tolerations to nvidia-device-plugin daemonset so kube-scheduler can place GPU pods once nodes are Ready
Maya: patch applied: `kubectl -n kube-system patch ds nvidia-device-plugin --patch "{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"tolerations\":[{\"key\":\"nvidia.com/gpu\",\"operator\":\"Exists\",\"effect\":\"NoSchedule\"}]}}}}"` — starting rolling restart
Olivia: rolling restart in progress, showing pods rescheduling. Also re-queued an Argo rollback for the chart as follow-up
Arjun: terraform plan shows it wants to replace 3 gpu nodes because of launch_template change. Tried applying but hit quota limit in us-west-2 for p4d instances
Raj: requested temporary quota increase with cloud support; fallback plan was to spin spare on-demand g4dn to get capacity quickly but that crosses VPC peering constraints for subnet tagging
Maya: cost note: temporary on-demand GPUs ~= $2.2/hr per instance; we should track billing in the incident
Sre-oncall: nodes transitioned back to Ready after the daemonset patch and one manual kubelet restart on each host. GPU pods are running again
Olivia: follow-ups: pin the gpu-daemon helm chart to previous sha in gitops, add CI gate to prevent chart changes that remove tolerations on gpu nodegroups, and add terraform preflight to block launch_template drift without manual review
Arjun: filing infra-ticket INFRA-1022 to add preflight checks and quota alerting per region
Maya: adding cost follow-up to FIN-88 so procurement can review temporary quota spend if needed
Raj: great work everyone. Will keep the incident open for 2 more hours to watch pod eviction metrics :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks — will also add runbook steps about manual toleration patch and argocd rollback commands
Sre-oncall: assigning SRE-457 for runbook updates and postmortem
Olivia: closing loop: pushed chart rollback PR and pinned chart version in gitops; will monitor tomorrow morning
Maya: acknowledged, closing incident once stable
